ITEM 1 | Rectangular-cut pieces of meat with browned, slightly charred outer edges and pinkish-red interior showing fibrous grain, moist and juicy looking, firm and holding shape, roughly 2 to 3 cm thick, several chunks stacked on a dark green leafy base, covering about 20% of the plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy vegetable with thick pale green stem, wilted and glossy, lying under and beside the meat pieces, covering about 6% of the plate | 35
ITEM 3 | Bright orange-yellow long-grain rice with separate grains, slightly glossy, dry and fluffy, a few darker flecks visible, spread in a mound about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1.5 cm high, covering about 18% of the plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slight yellowish tint, firm, matte surface with small bumps, clustered in three pieces about 4 to 5 cm across, lightly cooked, covering about 15% of the plate | 110
